description: Jan Haringstraat 6-18 (BAG 1938-39), told by the photo on Jasper Leijnsenstraat and Willem de Zwijgerlaan 183-195: 6.1 m red-brick fronts of five storeys with a white-framed two-over-two window pair per storey (a 2.35 m and a 1.2 m window, mirrored every pand so the windows pair across the party wall), a ribbon of small attic windows between white piers under a thin white flat eaves slab at 15 m; ground: a wide window and a door (paired house doors under a light canopy) at the party wall

match.note: Haringstraat 6-18 (7 pands 1938-39, 3DBAG eaves 14.7-15.4 m, ridge = eaves: flat); Leijnsenstraat 11-19 and Zwijgerlaan 185-195 have the same year, width and eaves and are told by the photo (auto-place --photo-decides)

flat-slab.note: Haringstraat 6-18 strip: a white eaves slab 14.4-15.0 m over the attic ribbon; flat roof

door-right.note: a 2.35 m ground window 0.75-2.4 m and the house door against the party wall (the door slot 1.2 m), a light canopy at 2.6 m over paired doors; mirrored when the strip reads the door on the left

roof.evidence: Haringstraat 6-18 strip: sky directly over the white eaves slab; 3DBAG ridge = eaves

rhythm.bays: wide + narrow window per pand, mirrored
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: window + door | 1-3: wide + narrow | 4: ribbon of 6
rhythm.symmetry: mirrored pairs about the party wall
rhythm.groundFloor: wide window, house door at the party wall under a canopy
rhythm.roofline: thin white flat slab over an attic ribbon

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-11 at 40 px/m gridded 1 m (grid crop 240-1240 px): windows 2.35 and 1.2 m wide, sills 3.6, 6.6, 9.6 m, heads 5.5, 8.5, 11.5 m, ground window 0.75-2.4 m; attic ribbon 13.1-14.0 m between piers 3.06 m apart; white eaves slab 14.4-15.0 m; party walls every 6.1 m
